title: The Ingot Vault
text: A vault door stands half open. Inside, ingots of iron and silver are stacked to the ceiling, and nobody guards them. The floor before the door is scorched in a perfect black circle. In the middle of it stand two boots, still smoking.

options.label: The quickest dashes in and out before the circle can light.

outcomes.text: They come out with an armful of ingots, the soles of their boots smoking.
The circle flares while they are still inside it, searing their legs.

options.label: The sharpest searches for the trigger before anyone steps into the circle.

outcomes.text: They find a pressure plate worn smooth by those who came before. You step around it carefully.

options.label: Leave it. The trap is too obvious, and those boots are a warning.

outcomes.text: As you go, a rat runs across the scorched circle. It flares white, and when the light fades the rat is gone. You will know such circles when you see them again.
